description: [CHECK · internal] Report a community item (group_contribution, mesh_message, door_note) to the moderation floor. One report is a claim, never a verdict; at three DISTINCT reporters the item is held for a HUMAN steward's review (Deut 19:15). The counter never judges — it decides when a person must look. A report must be SIGNED (call moderation_signable first): three witnesses means three keys, never three invented names.
name: report
